title: 第631章 莫问天可敢一战第630章 天路之地各方云集
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
第631章莫问天，可敢一战
在“莫问天”疑惑注视下。
琉璃圣女上前一步：“此番我会进入天庭，我会助你灭杀夜洐，我要彻底了结与夜洐的恩怨。”
她本该澄澈悲悯的佛眸，却藏着刺骨的杀意，语气冷冽，丝毫不像是是佛门圣女该有的慈悲，反倒更像是是一尊罗刹。
夜洐暗自打量琉璃圣女。
她怎么对我这么大的杀气？
不过在玄黄秘境一战罢了，秘境之争，秘境之后恩怨自清。
夜洐回忆，似乎对她没做过什么过分的事，就是差点杀了她，但不是没杀死吗？不过生撕了她的手臂罢了，这么小的事而已。
现在不是已经治好了吗。
怎么这么大的杀心？好歹也是佛门圣女，居然如此记仇。
夜洐心中丝毫没感到压力，他暗自估算琉璃圣女此时渗透的气息，大约八境初期，境界相同时都不是我对手，现在境界低于我，有什么资格找我复仇？
其他仙子，也诧异看着琉璃圣女，就算看不破她的真实境界，但玄黄秘境她还是七境，这才过去多久，不可能比得了八境后期乃至巅峰的人物。
“小西天，势要屠魔，圣女何须亲自出手？”瑶音委婉劝说道。
她当然期待，更多人针对奉天教敌人夜洐。
但你琉璃圣女这不是去送死？何况拿什么抢走一个名额？小西天总不可能没有八境后期或者巅峰的人物吧？
“我自有办法拿下一道天路名额。”琉璃圣女语气自信。
需要维护莫问天善良的人设，夜洐出口劝阻：“天庭之中危机四伏，圣女还望三思。”
琉璃圣女眼底掠过一缕浓郁心魔黑气，佛光都压不住翻涌的执念，声音冰寒刺骨：“不必再劝，今日我必入天庭，与夜洐彻底了结所有恩怨。”
“心魔？”夜洐诧异看着她，不少人也看到琉璃圣女情况不对。
琉璃圣女在心魔的渲染下，本该悲悯的玉容，越发狰狞。

她曾经消失的心魔，再次出现。
此前，她以为夜洐胆小怯懦，不敢奔赴东海城，心中魔障消散，镇压住心魔，也顺势突破到八境。
认为前方大道一片坦途。
最后发现，自己所以为的，只是自以为是。
夜洐不仅亲临东海城，并且大获全胜，事后更是做出震惊天下的大事，让她已经镇压消散的心魔，再度卷土重来，魔念比从前更深，更可怕。
若是再不解决，心魔便永无根除之日。
听闻琉璃圣女的自述。
其他仙子控诉夜洐的恶行。
夜洐自己心底很是无语，玄黄秘境之后，他都快忘记琉璃圣女是谁，压根没想到她如此不经打，会对自己产生了心魔。
但夜洐心中可没有一丝愧疚感，当初玄黄秘境是她主动找上门挑战，她能活着，已经是她运气不错，实力不错的原因。
“秘境机缘我分毫不求，只求与你联手诛杀夜洐，你不必担忧我拖后腿，我专修一门佛门禁术，短时间内修为战力可直接翻倍，足以比肩各大八境之巅强者。”琉璃圣女为说服“莫问天”，把一切底牌都告知。
她相信，要拿下夜洐，眼前天命之子的莫问天，是最可能成功的一人。
"我只要夜洐死，其余一切一无所求，我早已修炼佛门祖庭经法，对其余经法再无想法，至于天命珠，我修宏愿大道，本就是诸天最易渡过天劫的道途，无需天命珠。”
content_en:
Chapter 631 Mo Wentian, do you dare to fight?
Under the suspicious gaze of "Mo Wentian".
The Glazed Saint took a step forward and said, "This time I will enter the Heavenly Court, and I will help you kill Ye Tiao. I want to completely settle my grudges with Ye Tiao."
Her Buddha eyes, which should have been clear and compassionate, concealed a bone-chilling murderous intent, and her tone was cold. It did not look like the compassion that a Buddhist saint should have, but more like a Rakshasa.
Ye Hao secretly looked at the Glazed Saint.
Why is she so murderous towards me?
It's just a battle in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, a battle in the Secret Realm, and the grudges will be cleared up after the Secret Realm.
Ye Tao recalled that he didn't seem to have done anything excessive to her, but he almost killed her, but didn't he? He just tore her arm off, it was just such a small thing.
Isn't it cured now?
Why are you so murderous? She is a Buddhist saint after all, but she actually holds a grudge like this.
Ye Tao didn't feel any pressure in his heart. He secretly estimated that the aura permeating the Holy Girl of Glazed Glass at this time was around the early stage of the Eighth Realm. When the realm was the same, she was no match for me. Now that the realm is lower than mine, what qualifications do you have to seek revenge from me?
The other fairies also looked at the Glazed Saint in surprise. Even if they could not see through her true realm, she was still in the seventh realm of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. It had only been so long, and it was impossible to compare with those in the late or even peak stages of the eighth realm.
"Xiao Xitian is going to kill the demon, why does the saint need to take action herself?" Yao Yin advised tactfully.
Of course she expected more people to target Ye Hui, the enemy of the Fengtian Sect.
But aren’t you, the Glazed Saint, going to die? Besides, what are you using to steal a spot? It’s impossible for Xiao Xitian not to have characters in the late or peak stages of the Eighth Realm, right?
"I have my own way to win a spot on the Heavenly Road." The Glazed Saint said confidently.
Needing to maintain Mo Wentian's kind-hearted persona, Ye Hui dissuaded him: "There are dangers in heaven, so the saint should think twice."
A wisp of strong inner demonic black energy flashed across the eyes of the Holy Girl of Glaze. The Buddha's light could not suppress the surging obsession, and her voice was cold and bone-chilling: "No need to persuade her anymore, I will go to heaven today to completely settle all grievances with Ye Hui."
"Inner demon?" Ye Hao looked at her in surprise. Many people also saw that something was wrong with the Glazed Saint.
Under the exaggeration of the inner demon, the jade face that should have been compassionate became more and more ferocious.
Her inner demons that had disappeared reappeared.
Previously, she thought that Ye Hao was timid and cowardly and did not dare to rush to Donghai City. The demonic barriers in her heart dissipated, suppressed her inner demons, and successfully broke through to the eighth realm.
I think the road ahead is smooth.
In the end, I discovered that what I thought was just self-righteousness.
Not only did Ye Tao come to Donghai City in person and win a great victory, she even did something that shocked the world afterwards, causing her inner demons that had been suppressed and dissipated to come back again, and their demonic thoughts were deeper and more terrifying than before.
If it is not resolved, the inner demons will never be eradicated.
Listen to the self-narration of the Glazed Saint.
The other fairies accused Ye Hu of his evil deeds.
Ye Tao was speechless in his heart. After entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he almost forgot who the Glazed Saint was. He didn't expect that she would have inner demons for him because she was so careless.
But Ye Tao didn't feel a trace of guilt in her heart. She had taken the initiative to challenge the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. The reason why she was alive was because of her good luck and good strength.
"I don't ask for any chance in the secret realm. I just want to join forces with you to kill Ye Hu. You don't have to worry about me holding you back. I specialize in a Buddhist forbidden technique. In a short period of time, my training and combat power can be doubled, which is enough to compete with the top eight realms." In order to convince "Mo Wentian", the Holy Girl of Glazed Glass told "Mo Wentian" all her trump cards.
She believed that Mo Wentian, the son of destiny, was the one most likely to succeed in taking down Ye Wei.
"I only want to die at night, and I want nothing else. I have already practiced the Buddhist ancestral court sutras, and I have no idea about other sutras. As for the Destiny Pearl, I cultivate the Great Wish Path. It is the easiest way for all gods to survive the catastrophe, and there is no need for the Destiny Pearl."
